admission.justification: The snapshot adapter constructs forward and reverse references while docHead.tsx renders their known metadata, preventing a task head from presenting only half of the declared dependency relation.

applicability: Dependency facts in the head of a task of an ordinary master.
conditions: Waits-for references come from the field; needed-by references are derived from the listed sibling population.
Known reference titles and states remain visible, including gone references; absent document paths do not acquire invented navigation.

evidence: Parent examination of actual F01 changed extents; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: A task head presents its waits-for and derived needed-by tasks with their known titles and states.
